headline: EMC and KC were the sharpest decliners, while PROP and CONS names dominated the unusual-trading alerts; TPOLY’s alert follows its disclosed debenture-interest default.
market_take: Coverage was broadly mixed, with sharp downside in EMC (-50.00%), KC (-33.33%), and PF (-20.00%), alongside gains in RML (+12.50%), CGD (+11.11%), and NRF (+9.52%). PROP and CONS generated most of the highlighted unusual activity. Recent filings add event risk around TPOLY, AKS, A5, NVD, BTG, and DCON.

sector_notes.note: RML (+12.50%) and CGD (+11.11%) led notable gains, while KC (-33.33%) and PF (-20.00%) were major decliners. JCK, ORI, ANAN, STELLA, RICHY, A5, and DCON also had highlighted alerts or filings.
EMC fell -50.00% with a 7.51× volume ratio and multiple unusual-trading alerts. TPOLY’s -10.00% open-gap alert followed its filing on a debenture-interest default.
F&D declined -12.43%, while NRF rose +9.52%. BTG had a 6.4σ volume spike and a recent filing on the acquisition of shares in an indirect subsidiary.
CCP had a -7.14% open-gap alert, while DCON had a +6.67% open-gap alert and an intraday move of -6.25%; DCON also disclosed a connected-transaction clarification.
